metric_definitions.first_result_seconds: wall time from submitting the prompt file to process completion of a complete, parseable answer; cases whose output did not parse are named in first_result_missing_cases instead of contributing a latency
metric_definitions.cold_start_seconds: wall time of the first case after provisioning, whose process paid the cold weight page-in
metric_definitions.runtime_reported_load_seconds: llama.cpp load time; per S5 observation it is finalized at the first eval and overlaps the first prefill, so it is not a separate cold-start measure
metric_definitions.prefill: llama.cpp prompt eval tokens over measured prompt eval time; medians across cases
metric_definitions.decode: llama.cpp eval tokens over measured eval time; medians across cases
metric_definitions.process_peak_rss_mib: max sampled VmHWM/VmRSS of the llama-completion process
metric_definitions.process_peak_pss_mib: max sampled PSS from /proc/<pid>/smaps_rollup of that process
metric_definitions.device_mem_available: device MemAvailable from /proc/meminfo, not a process budget

metrics.warm_caveat: cold n=1 per profile; a per-case cold distribution requires page-cache eviction that this phone does not permit
